title: Gómez-Gálvez et al. (2018) scutoid packing on curved epithelial tubes — reference identities and Hannezo-coupled fold-crest geometry

primary_paper.authors: Gómez-Gálvez P, Vicente-Munuera P, Tagua A, Forja C, Castro AM, Letrán M, Valencia-Expósito A, Grima C, Bermúdez-Gallardo M, Serrano-Pérez-Higueras Ó, Cavodeassi F, Sotillos S, Martín-Bermudo MD, Márquez A, Buceta J, Escudero LM
primary_paper.title: Scutoids are a geometrical solution to three-dimensional packing of epithelia
primary_paper.doi_verification: Not re-resolved online in Pass 3 (offline round); DOI matches the entry already vendored by Slot 029 (morphoeval/kg/2026-10-19-somitoid-chirality-buckling-audit-v3).

model_description.voronoi_tube: Cell seeds on the unrolled apical cylinder (circumference 2*pi*R_a, doubly periodic) are tessellated by a periodic Voronoi diagram; the same seeds are projected radially to the basal cylinder R_b, where the circumferential coordinate scales by the surface ratio s = R_b / R_a, and tessellated again. A cell whose apical and basal neighbour sets differ is a scutoid (its lateral face carries an apico-basal vertex / neighbour intercalation).
model_description.coupling_to_hannezo: h_0 and d_0 of the tube cells come from Hannezo, Prost & Joanny (2014) Law 1 (h_0/d_0 = c*Gamma_l/[4(Gamma_a+Gamma_b)], V_0 conserved); for a tube with apical lumen R_b = R_a + h_0, for a villus-like basal lumen R_b = R_a - h_0. For buckled sheets the local surface ratio at a fold crest is s_crest = 1 + h_0 * kappa_max with kappa_max the maximal apico-basal curvature of the relaxed sheet w(x, y).
model_description.seed_generation: Hexagonal lattice of spacing ~d_0 jittered by 0.28 d_0 (Gaussian), followed by 2 Lloyd (centroidal) iterations on the periodic domain; three RNG replicates per sweep point.
model_description.parameter_status: All numerical values below are either exact geometric identities or quantities derived from the already-pinned epithelial_buckling_3d_reference.json (WT amplitude, wavelength, h_0). None is a digitised value from the Gómez-Gálvez figures; the paper is used for the mechanism (scutoid number increases monotonically with surface ratio, none at s = 1, scutoids reduce the lateral-energy of the packing relative to frusta).

geometric_identities.scutoid_fraction_at_unity_note: s = 1 is an isometry of the seed set, so apical and basal Voronoi diagrams coincide (Lean Law 4 `isometric_projection_has_no_scutoids`).
geometric_identities.scutoid_fraction_monotone_note: Gómez-Gálvez et al. (2018) Fig. 2: the number of scutoids in Voronoi tubes increases with the surface ratio; the reference is perfect rank monotonicity.
geometric_identities.euler_mean_neighbors_note: Trivalent tessellation of a torus: 3V = 2E and V - E + F = 0 imply 2E = 6F on both the apical and the basal surface (Lean Law 5 `trivalent_torus_neighbor_conservation`).
geometric_identities.lateral_area_ratio_note: Ratio of total lateral face area of the scutoid tessellation to the intercalation-free frustum tessellation (projected apical polygons); values < 1 mean the intercalation lowers the Gamma_l-weighted lateral energy, consistent with the energy argument of Gómez-Gálvez et al. (2018) Fig. 5.
